events.verdict: As Lillard (MIL) stops and changes directions, Carter Jr. (ORL) continues moving forwards and the foot contact with Lillard is marginal.
Trent Jr.'s (MIL) brushes Suggs' (ORL) front and does not affect his SQBR. The contact is highlighted by Suggs briefly grasping Trent Jr.'s extended arm.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) engage and disengage during the rebound.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) initiates illegal arm contact with Carter Jr. (ORL) during Carter Jr.'s upward shooting motion.
Black (ORL) and Lillard (MIL) engage and disengage off ball.
Middleton (MIL) fully extends his left hand into Black's (ORL) back, forcing him into Trent Jr. (MIL).
Lillard (MIL) steps inside the three-point arc and Middleton (MIL) enters the lane prior to the release of Black's (ORL) free throw attempt.
Lillard (MIL) gathers the ball on his left foot and legally takes two steps before elevating for the shot attempt.
Suggs (ORL) places his off-arm against Trent Jr. (MIL) and releases to receive the throw-in. Trent Jr. is not dislodged from his defensive position as a result of the contact from Suggs.
Lillard (MIL) legally contests Suggs' (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Middleton (MIL) is already beginning to lose his balance when Black (ORL) briefly grasps his jersey.

Replay review of the foul called on Bitadze (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Bitadze made contact with the ball and causes it to become dislodged from Portis's (MIL) possession, and a foul was not warranted. The ball was awarded to MIL because at the point of interruption (the whistle), Portis clearly and conclusively would have imminently gained possession of the ball given his proximity to -- and pursuit of it -- relative to Bitadze and Carter Jr. (ORL).
Carter Jr. (ORL) reaches in and grabs Lillard's (MIL) arm as he receives the throw-in.
Trent Jr. (MIL) legally contests Suggs' (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) initiates contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) right arm and left shoulder during the rebound.
Trent Jr. (MIL) initiates contact with Howard's (ORL) left arm during his upward shooting motion.
Howard's (ORL) free throw attempt does not make contact with the rim.
Howard (ORL) commits a take foul on Lillard (MIL).
